Online checkout funnel for a regional grocery retailer, Jan-Mar 2024

The e-commerce team logged every session step for the first quarter of 2024 while a redesigned cart page was rolled out, to see where shoppers stop.

|---|---|---|
| `basket_value` | measure | unit USD; additive |
| `bounce_rate` | measure | unit rate; non-additive |

| `day_of_week` | category | Mon, Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun; ordered=ordinal; derived from event_date; group calendar |
| `device` | category | Desktop, Mobile, Tablet; group acquisition |
| `dwell_seconds` | measure | unit seconds; additive |
| `event_date` | time | 2024-01-01 to 2024-03-31, daily; group calendar |
| `is_weekend` | category | No, Yes; ordered=ordinal; derived from event_date; group calendar |
| `month` | category | 2024-01, 2024-02, 2024-03; ordered=ordinal; derived from event_date; group calendar |
| `stage` | category | Landing, Product, Cart, Checkout, Purchase; ordered=stage; group funnel |
